chars.BOSS: a heavyset Moroccan man in his 50s with a thick black moustache and receding grey hair, wearing a maroon polo shirt, dark grey trousers and a gold watch
chars.NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man about 19 with short curly black hair, wearing a faded blue work overall dusted with aluminium shavings and white sneakers
chars.GIRL: a young woman in her 20s with long dyed auburn hair, wearing a black satin dress and big gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the front gate of a modest Moroccan villa in Mohammedia: BOSS freezes in a half-open front door, startled and guilty, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible; behind him in the hallway GIRL quickly turns away. Comic awkward tension, afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: BOSS lounging on a sofa in a Moroccan salon with zellige cushions, talking on his mobile phone with a bossy commanding gesture, ordering someone around, smug face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR walking up a quiet Mohammedia residential street toward a villa gate, holding a pack of cigarettes, annoyed tired face, sunny afternoon.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stopping in front of a villa front door that is left half open, leaning to peek inside, curious surprised face, seen from the side.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the half-open villa door, NARRATOR hands a pack of cigarettes to BOSS while looking away at the ceiling, pretending he saw nothing; BOSS grabs it nervously, sweating. Comic awkward moment.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside an aluminium window workshop with aluminium profiles and a cutting saw, BOSS stands over NARRATOR pointing a finger at him and shouting arrogantly; NARRATOR keeps his head down, holding an aluminium frame.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR alone in the aluminium workshop clenching his fist, jaw tight, eyes burning with anger, looking toward the boss's empty office chair.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sitting on an overturned crate in the workshop at dusk, chin on his hand, thinking hard with a scheming look, a small mischievous idea forming on his face.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In front of the villa, BOSS waves goodbye with a fake smile as a small car drives away loaded with suitcases on the roof, a middle-aged woman in a headscarf and a teenage girl visible through the car windows; BOSS looks secretly pleased.
